thread:
Nora H: Customer asks for "stable-egress" for Private installs + safe operator upgrades. Need proposal by next planning.
Vikram P: Clarify stable-egress: preserved external IPs via NAT is ok?
Nora H: Yes, NAT with stable mapping preferred. Relay as fallback.
Sam K: Proposed pieces: installer flag, network-template CRD, verification step, auto-rollback policy.
Vikram P: Verification must be deterministic: webhook echo returns client-observed IP, traceroute sanity, and control-plane health metrics.
Eve C: For airgapped sites, ship a verification proxy container that returns signed attestations to controller.
Sam K: Rollback policy: default 10m monitor window. Allow template param "upgrade.timeout" to extend; >1h requires explicit approval.
Vikram P: Need runtime checkpoint API so operator can snapshot pre-upgrade state. I'll file spike.
Nora H: Launch gated on: schema validated in 2 pilot customers, rollback tested, airgap proxy validated, docs + NetOps runbook ready.
ops-bot: Schema PR opened: network_template.v3 with fields: egress_mode, verification_proxy, "upgrade.timeout".
Sam K: Action items: Vikram spike, Eve proxy artifact, Nora docs stub, coordinate pilot comms.
Vikram P: will spike and drop results in the thread.
ops-bot: thread archived when closed. :white_check_mark:
